Five columns with names that do not break. They are wider than a phone, so
the table scrolls in its box and the page does not scroll sideways.

| serve-listen | serve-token | doctor-check | setup-keychain | reset-all |
| serve-port | serve-host | doctor-fix | setup-account | reset-keys |
